intervention_detail: One assignment message per lane (the dispatch itself, not a mid-flight intervention). Zero nudges, zero clarifications, zero stall-recoveries, zero scope corrections after dispatch. Lead activity between dispatch and close was read-only verification (TaskList, jq on packets, git porcelain), which does not consume teammate turns.
note: Team-arm coordinator labor was comparable to the subagent baseline (0.64 vs ~0.60 of sequential) for THIS bounded two-lane planning slice with 0 mid-flight interventions. CAVEAT: the lanes were small, disjoint, and read-only, so none of the known v2.1.177 team limitations (task-status lag, slow shutdown, no resume) were stressed. Do not extrapolate this favorable ratio to long-running or contended team work.
